messages.subject: Pass mass matrix to CmdStan (possible feature request) / Initialize from diagnostics file
parts:
Dear Stan developels,

I would like to run the warmup and the sampling for my Stan model separately.
I could do one warm-up run to compute my stepsize and mass matrix, and then
start my sampling. However, it seems that currently I am not able to pass the
mass matrix to Stan directly... Or could I initialize my model with a diagnostics.csv file
and I have overlooked it in the user guide?

If not, I would be glad if I could pass the mass matrix values to Stan, for example,
via *.data.R file. Is it possible?

Best regards,
Arseniy Tsipenyuk.
